purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for the single Stödassistenten learning system. Scores are ordinal discovery priorities, not measured search volumes or eligibility evidence. VAB and sickness-benefit rules are truth-bearing only after current primary-source verification; discovery material is never used as fact.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage. These scores guide eval, retrieval and question-order work only.

natural_language_queries: jag är sjukskriven 50 procent kan jag vabba resten av dagen
barnet är sjukt och jag är sjukskriven deltid vilka timmar kan jag vabba
kan jag få sjukpenning och vab samma dag
vem ska jag fråga om vab när min arbetstid är förlagd annorlunda under deltidssjukskrivning

demand_signal.basis: VAB and part-time sickness absence are both broad national social-insurance situations that can overlap for working parents. The score is a qualitative product-priority signal, not measured query volume.

friction_signal.basis: A percentage such as 50 percent sounds sufficient, but current guidance makes exact hours, the parent's own sickness status and other same-day benefits material. Work-time placement can also differ from a simple half-day split.

miss_consequence.basis: A false-positive answer can lead to a VAB claim for time when the parent was themselves sick or to overlapping benefit claims, while an overly broad rejection can make the user miss a potentially relevant non-overlapping work-time route.

source_fragmentation.basis: The safe route spans current Försäkringskassan VAB guidance, same-day control guidance and part-time sickness-benefit work-time rules rather than one simple percentage rule.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Terms such as sjukskrivningsgrad, arbetstidens förläggning, samma timmar and annan ersättning samma dag are easy to flatten into a misleading daily percentage, especially under family time pressure.

steps_to_action.basis: The route can be shortened to a few high-information facts: exact sick-leave hours, exact hours otherwise worked, whether the parent is self-sick/sick-reported for the requested time and whether another benefit covers the same hours.

recurrence_signal.basis: The overlap is structurally recurring whenever a working parent has part-time sickness absence and a child-care interruption. This is a qualitative recurrence signal, not a measured frequency claim.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The scenario system separately covered part-time sickness-benefit scheduling and VAB boundaries, but did not permanently test their same-day hour-level intersection. The employee coverage matrix also identified work + family responsibility + sickness as an area needing more combination cases.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Add a permanent fail-closed combination regression that asks for exact hour overlap before treating a part-time sickness percentage as available VAB time, and use the finding to improve future question order for work + family + sickness cases.
signals.truth_rule: Verify current VAB and part-time sickness-benefit rules against Försäkringskassan; do not infer eligibility or an available VAB percentage from the sickness percentage alone, and do not claim two benefits for the same hours are valid without current authority verification.
